look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Find a low, spreading nightshade-family perennial with deeply wavy or lobed, hairy gray-green leaves. Check its small pale five-lobed flowers and later rounded berries; inspect flower/fruit structures to separate other Chamaesaracha species rather than relying on leaf outline alone.
